column1: # CTR Log — Confidential Treatment Request History
# Source: SEC EDGAR full-text search for "confidential treatment" in 13F filings;
#         SEC Division of Investment Management CTR order releases;
#         academic literature (Agarwal et al. 2013 JF dataset).
# CRITICAL: Positions granted CTR were NOT publicly disclosed at the time of the
# original 13F filing. Including them in the signal at signal-construction time
# constitutes look-ahead bias. This log is used to:
#   (1) Flag contaminated ticker-quarters for exclusion from backtests
#   (2) Audit whether CTR inclusion materially affects results (bias test)
#   (3) Document the universe of known hidden positions for academic reference
# ctr_subsequently_disclosed: True if the position was eventually disclosed
# disclosure_lag_quarters: how many quarters after the original filing the
#   position became public (1-4 quarters is typical; SEC grants max 1 year)
